faq_heading: Homes near Willoughby Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Willoughby Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Langley School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Willoughby Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Willoughby Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: How much do homes near Willoughby Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 554 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,470,000, townhomes $830,000, condos $555,000. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Willoughby Elementary?
faq.a: Within 1 km of Willoughby Elementary the median was 20 days on the market, closing at 98.1% of the list price, with 6% of sales above the list price for the 554 homes within 1 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Willoughby Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Richard Bulpitt Elementary (0.5 km south-east), Donna Gabriel Robins Elementary (0.6 km west) and Lynn Fripps Elementary (0.8 km north-east).

Willoughby Elementary is an elementary school in Langley (Langley School District), at 20766 80 Ave. It teaches grades K to 5.
Use the search below to see homes for sale that name Willoughby Elementary in the listing, then check the sold prices within 1 km of the school.
How the Willoughby Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Willoughby Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 1 km of Willoughby Elementary sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 554 homes sold within 1 km of Willoughby Elementary: 63 houses, 249 townhomes and 216 condos. The largest group was townhomes, at a median of $830,000.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Willoughby Elementary

17 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Willoughby Elementary in a straight line (12 elementary, 2 middle, 2 secondary, 1 other; 1 independent). The closest is Richard Bulpitt Elementary, 0.5 km away, and the farthest on this list is Maddaugh Elementary, 2.9 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is R E Mountain Secondary (1.3 km); the nearest independent school is The King's School (2.2 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Alex Hope Elementary (1.3 km). Other elementary schools close by: Richard Bulpitt Elementary (0.5 km south-east), Donna Gabriel Robins Elementary (0.6 km west), Lynn Fripps Elementary (0.8 km north-east), Alex Hope Elementary (1.3 km north-east), Josette Dandurand Elementary (1.4 km north-west). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-5) is Richard Bulpitt Elementary, 0.5 km south-east of Willoughby Elementary.
